data.summary: Reviews show mixed authenticity. Positive reviews are numerous but some feel promotional, while the single detailed negative review raises credible concerns about project management and quality control. The company has strong BBB accreditation and generally positive ratings, but the Trustpilot discrepancy and pattern of employee-focused praise warrant caution.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews mention the same employees (Dominic, Adam, Brandon) in a promotional tone
Some 5-star reviews feel overly effusive and similar in structure

negative_evidence: Negative review mentions having to involve an attorney to get issues resolved

authentic_signals: Specific employee names and roles mentioned
Detailed descriptions of project issues in negative review
Varied writing styles and specific project details
Negative review provides concrete examples of problems (tile without grout, coping issues)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Trustpilot shows a 2.1 rating with 9 reviews, which is a significant negative outlier compared to the 4.6-4.7 ratings on Google and Angi. However, the Trustpilot sample is very small and may not be representative of the local DFW branch's performance.

reviews.text: After reviewing many contractors for our pool project, we choose Anthony & Sylvan after speaking with Brandon. From his thoughtful design work to the overall build experience with Anthony & Sylvan—supported by Dominic Rodrigues  and Adam Beeson as our main points of contact—everything came together beautifully. Building a pool requires patience no matter who you choose, but Dominic Rodrigues consistently addressed my questions and concerns and clearly explained each step of the process. We made a few changes along the way, and Adam Beeson handled them seamlessly, offering practical solutions that kept the project moving forward. Overall, it was a great experience, and we a happy customer with a beautiful pool in the backyard.
reviews.author: Lokesh

reviews.text: Anthony and Sylvan did a great job constructing my pool and creating my family’s personal oasis.  Adam Beeson, project manager, has been a partner in assuring we were on track with completion and any service tickets were completed in a timely fashion.  Thank you Adam for being there to answer any questions and providing professional service to assure our oasis is functional all year round!  Thanks for the great job and will refer Anthony and sylvan to my family and friends if in the need of a pool!
reviews.author: Paul Carrillo

reviews.text: Dominic is THE POOL PROFESSIONAL. Dom has eased my worries as this was a first time in ground pool build for myself and my family. He needs to train others. He is a keeper. Thank You Dom!! Appreciate all you do. (He lets me call him Dom 😎)
reviews.author: EDGAR STILES

reviews.text: From the concept photos done by Brandon to the overall build experience with Dominic as my PM, the pool has turned out beautifully! Building a pool is for the patient no matter who you use. As long as I made sure to voice my wants and concerns, Dominic was quick to get it done or explain the process.
reviews.author: Erin Hubbard

reviews.text: We are so excited about our new pool. Its been a great experience from day one! Our project manager Dominic is the best! He keeps on constant contact with us and is  very caring snd helpful.. We are very  pleased with Anthony Sylvan and will highly recommend them! to all.
reviews.author: Tammi Samons

reviews.text: Adam Beeson is the best in the pool industry, from the start of being the project Manager in building my pool and keeping up with all my questions, always returning my phone calls, reassuring that everything was gonna be taken care of and that it was taken care of. He’s very professional, knows the pool industry very well. He is always kind and pleasant when I call. He’s the best….
reviews.author: Brenda Rekieta

reviews.text:
It took 8 months and an attorney! Go elsewhere! Pay attention to the other reviews and you will notice that most were written prior to project completion. My dig date was November 2023 and after 8 months, still not complete. The project management was beyond poor and workmanship even worse. Waterline tile was installed with no grout. Coping had to be redone twice due to wrong size, uneven cutting, incorrect grout color and the wrong stone finish. When given the opportunity to redo and reselect, it took nearly 8 weeks to resume the work even though the supplies were in stock with the vendor.

My lower deck was not installed according to the contracted plans. The surrounding deck is uneven with trip hazards. Several coping pieces were severely chipped at installation and when replaced, the colors did not match. Project managers are never here to direct the trades.

Trades did not show up when scheduled and no one from A&S would even call. They work unsupervised and project managers do not come out to inspect their work. Instead, it was left up to me to report problems. No one ever calls to ask how things are going. They simply do not care.

A pre-plaster punch list was compiled but never completed but they rushed to get the pool filled because they knew 7 months was completely unacceptable for this project. My pool is only 10x10, tiny.

The manager tried to silence me from going public but it is important to me that their shady practices and shoddy work be exposed. No one should have to experience this. I missed the entire summer and swim season on a project that began before Thanksgiving the prior year. Now almost a year later and I still do not have a completed project.

I escalated to corporate and never even received the courtesy or a call or email in return. Their in-house attorney is clueless and will cause this to go to litigation.

Again, please go elsewhere. It cannot get any worse than Anthony & Sylvan.
reviews.author: Ni B

reviews.text: I absolutely CANNOT say enough good things about Heidi, our design consultant. Not only is she kind and professional, her communication is incredibly stellar and she truly cares for the people she interacts with. Heidi went above and beyond- doing things for us that were definitely not in her job description! She was always quick to offer any help we needed or answer questions promptly. As we navigated a family emergency, Heidi stepped in to do legwork that was a huge blessing to us. She continues to be a point of contact through the construction process and is amazing at her job! Such a wonderful person overall, and a JOY to work with!
reviews.author: Brooke Boyd
